requirements.statement: Render two editable option names and exactly three editable criterion rows.
Compute each option total as sum(score × weight) using bounded numeric inputs.
Provide a 180-second local timer with idle/running/paused/expired states; expiry locks comparison inputs until reset.
Require an explicit user choice; create a local receipt with selected option, both totals, UTC timestamp and deterministic rationale.
Copy receipt via Clipboard API with a graceful manual-copy fallback message.
Use semantic controls, visible focus styles, live timer/receipt status and responsive layout with no page-level horizontal overflow.
Use only browser-native APIs and existing Vite build tooling; no new runtime dependencies, network requests, storage or secrets.
